name: Open-interest-confirmed momentum — ride trends backed by real leverage inflow
rationale: Price momentum alone cannot tell apart a move funded by genuine new capital from a thin, low-conviction drift that fades. Open interest IS the missing confirmation: a rising OI alongside a rising price means NEW leveraged longs are being opened into the move (fresh money chasing), whereas a price rise on FLAT-or-falling OI is short-covering or spot-only churn that exhausts quickly. The hypothesis: long the assets whose price momentum (ret_Nd) is positive AND whose open_interest is building (cross_up through a fitted floor) — the OI build-up is the catalyst that distinguishes a real, capital-backed trend from noise. We hold while the trend persists and exit when OI stops confirming (open_interest cross_down — the leverage tide that was funding the move has turned) or risk limits hit. Spot-only LONG on Binance (direction=+1): OI is a perp-derived FEATURE here, read point-in-time as confirmation; we do NOT trade the perp, so no funding leg. Disconfirmer 1 (the core falsifier): the edge must come from OI CONFIRMING momentum, not from momentum alone. If dropping the open_interest conditions entirely and keeping only the ret_Nd momentum filter yields an equal-or-better deflated Sharpe, OI adds no orthogonal information and the claimed edge is just plain momentum already covered by the vol-gated specs. Disconfirmer 2: OI rises mechanically when price rises (more notional outstanding at a higher mark), so the cross_up could be a price proxy in disguise — if replacing the price-confirmation arm (ret_Nd gt mom_floor) with a price-DECLINE arm flips the sign of the edge, OI is not adding leverage-flow information, it is just tracking price. tier0 derivative feature, but the COMBINATION is unproven — low-confidence until validated OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: open_interest builds (new leveraged longs opening) WHILE price momentum is positive — capital-backed trend, not thin drift.
